labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks why \r does not overwrite a line and whether this is expected; Rich strips \r by design and Live is the documented way to redraw.

body:
Rich deliberately strips carriage returns from printed text (see https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/control.py), so `\r` will not overwrite the previous line with `rich.print`. To redraw a line in place, use the live display: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst (`Live` or `Progress`, with `transient=True` if the line should disappear when done).

For questions about how Rich behaves, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
